subject: Hotstart warmup lag — commercial exception request for pilot launch
messages:
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.p@nimbus.health>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hotstart warmup lag impacting pilot cost

Hi Soojin (and Laura),

Quick note from the ops side: since we flipped the new model routing yesterday we've seen a 2.7x increase in short-lived sessions during ramp, which is driving higher token spend for our pilot users. The feature your team shipped to reduce cold starts (the "hotstart" warmup path) isn't available in our region yet, so we're bearing the cost while the pilot is live.

We had planned the pilot go-live for next Monday; at the current burn rate we'll exceed the committed budget by ~USD 15k within the first week. Can Redwood provide a short-term commercial concession (credit or temporary rate) while the hotstart rollout completes? We prefer a simple credit applied to our next invoice or an interim discounted rate for the first two weeks of the pilot.

I've attached the pilot SOW and a quick ops snapshot. Happy to jump on a call if useful.

Thanks,
Rajiv
Rajiv Patel
VP of Engineering, Nimbus Health
rajiv.p@nimbus.health

Attachments: nimbus_pilot_sow.pdf (SOW, 3 pages), nimbus_cost_runbook.xlsx (ops cost export)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.p@nimbus.health>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hotstart warmup lag impacting pilot cost

Thanks Rajiv — and appreciate the clear numbers.

Short summary for internal folks: Nimbus pilot is burning ~2.7x expected during ramp because the hotstart warmup rollout hasn't reached the us-west region used by Nimbus. Product ETA for hotstart patch is 10 business days; infra can do a targeted hotfix earlier but requires validation. Customer asks a short-term commercial accommodation (credit or temporary discount for first two weeks).

Ask to leadership/finance: can we provisionally authorize a timeboxed credit for the pilot (proposal below) while we finish the rollout? I'll loop in Marcus for pricing approval and Legal for SOW amendment if we get signoff.

Proposed options for internal decision (quick):
- Option A (preferred): 25% credit on usage over the next 14 days, capped at $15k; requires finance signoff only.
- Option B: Fixed one-time credit of $12k applied to next invoice; faster to approve but less precise.
- Option C: Temporary discounted unit rate (example: -20% on per-token rate) for up to 14 days; needs repricing and billing change.

I attached the ops cost export Rajiv sent and a line-itemed cost breakdown (same file). If leadership approves, I'll prepare an Amended SOW and DocuSign envelope.

Next step: Karthik/Marcus — can you confirm which option you can authorize at your level? Monica, can CS stand up the pilot communications if we sign?

— Soojin
SoojIn Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Thanks Soojin — good catch and thanks Rajiv for the flag. A couple quick notes from me:

1) We need a concise justification in the HubSpot deal (ARR/expected expansion + why this pilot matters). Please update DEAL-10982 with the numbers and paste the ops snapshot.
2) For commercial exceptions: at my level I can sign off up to $8k one-time credit. Anything above needs Marcus / COO review.
3) Product: if the hotfix can be scoped down to a targeted region-level rollout that can be validated in 72 hours, we should prioritize that to reduce the window of exposure. Laura / Product Ops please confirm feasibility.

If Soojin thinks the $15k cap is necessary to keep the launch on track, escalate to Marcus with the ARR justification.

Appreciate the fast coordination. I'm authorizing a provisional commercial concession to protect the pilot timeline:

- Approved: One-time credit of $12,000 OR 25% credit on usage up to a maximum of $12,000 (whichever is lower).
- Conditions: Applies only to usage between 2028-03-22 and 2028-04-05; credit will be applied to the next invoice.
- Requirements: Soojin to submit updated HubSpot deal notes (DEAL-10982) with ARR/expansion rationale and attach the ops snapshot. Legal to prepare a short Amended SOW & DocuSign reflecting the concession. Finance will confirm final accounting treatment.

Monica: please draft the customer-facing note explaining the temporary accommodation and timeline; emphasize that the permanent fix is scheduled and that this is a one-time remediation to keep the pilot on schedule.

SoojIn — once you have the HubSpot update and customer comms, loop Legal and send the DocuSign request. I'll track the credit in billing.
